sentences.text: ?Court No. - 85

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13064 of 2022
Applicant :- Ashwani Dubey

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kamal Kishor Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.

Heard Sri Kamal Kishor Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State
and perused the record.

02. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant- Ashwani
Dubey with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.434 of 2021, under Sections 116, 120-B,
419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., P.S. Ramgarhtal, District Gorakhpur.

03.  As per prosecution case, certain persons were conversing with each other on video call that they shall earn money in collusion with Manager of the centres by working as solver gang in online examination to be conducted for police personnel in 2020-21.
It is alleged in the F.I.R. that on the basis of this conversation three persons namely Senapati Sahani, Nityanand Gaur and Anubhav Singh were arrested.
They disclosed the name of co-accused persons including the present applicant.
04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that he has been falsely implicated in this case for ulterior motive.
No such incident ever took place and that he is apprehending arrest without there being any cause for him to get arrested.
In fact during investigation no good evidence could be collected to show that he hatched conspiracy to act as member of the solver gang.

It is pointed out Ashwani Dubey vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163674580/
1 that co-accused Deepak, having an identical case has been granted anticipatory bail by another Bench of this Court vide order dated 05.04.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.1484 of 2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also argued that F.I.R puts an incredible story.
05. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
However, broad factual picture of the matter as aforesaid has not been repudiated.

06. It may be stated that in case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 07. In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
Hence, the present anticipatory bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
